name: Westlake Shopping Center
summary: Westlake Shopping Center is a community-focused shopping destination in Daly City featuring big-box retailers, specialty stores, and diverse dining options. This accessible neighborhood center serves local residents with convenient services and everyday shopping needs.
demographics: Westlake Shopping Center serves the diverse Daly City community, which has a significant Asian-American population and working to middle-class families. The trade area attracts budget-conscious shoppers seeking everyday necessities and value-oriented retail options, with typical visitors ranging from young families to seniors. The center draws from surrounding residential neighborhoods with median household incomes in the $80,000-$100,000 range, appealing to practical shoppers who prioritize convenience and affordability over luxury experiences.
description: Westlake Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located on Southgate Avenue in Daly City, California. This classic mall serves the diverse residential communities of northern San Mateo County with a practical mix of big-box retailers, specialty stores, and convenient services that cater to everyday shopping needs. The center offers visitors a range of dining options from quick-service eateries to sit-down restaurants, making it a one-stop destination for both shopping and meals. With its accessible location just south of San Francisco and ample parking, Westlake Shopping Center has become a neighborhood staple for residents seeking value and convenience. The property is managed by Kimco Realty and maintains strong community ties through its tenant mix that reflects the practical needs of local families and working professionals.
